DataShape.name: ResolvedDocument
DataShape.description: Resolved document set row for ResolveDocumentSet: documentId plus optional cross-cutting flags

FieldDefinition.name: documentId
FieldDefinition.description: Resolved document id (matches a document-knowledge package docId)

FieldDefinition.name: alwaysInclude
FieldDefinition.description: Cross-cutting: always include this document regardless of the asset key. Honored by the runtime — alwaysInclude rows are unioned into the scoped documentIds (resolver-sourced only).

FieldDefinition.name: appliesToMany
FieldDefinition.description: Cross-cutting: document applies to many assets (parsed and surfaced on the tool wire; inert in the runtime — no separate effect yet)
